_meta.purpose: Atomic dashboard fragments captured 1:1 from the catalog block frames. patterns.json composes them via $ref.
_meta.spacingModel: MEASURED from the canonical catalog cards: Card spacing "small" = 12px padding WITH a 12px ("sm") content gap; panels/cards to each other 16px ("md"). So R = sm (elements in a card, card padding), R−1 = xs (grouped: title+description, label+badge), R−2 = 2xs (tight inline pairs), R+1 = md (panel rows, grid gaps). A card's content gap must NEVER exceed its padding — a 16px gap in a 12px card pushes the rows further apart than the card edge and visually breaks the card; the audit reports it as gap-exceeds-card-padding.
_meta.columnModel: A data row is a ContainerHorizontal whose children each fillWidth — that is how the catalog builds its five equal columns. There is NO five-column Grid variant; never invent one. A cell that holds a Badge or Link wraps it in a fill-width container so the hug-sized control keeps the column width. This includes the LEADING Checkbox cell and the HEADER row: a checkbox left at its auto width keeps its label width, so the header grid and the row grid drift apart by the label length difference ("Auswahl" vs "ICE 101 Hamburg–Berlin"). The header row therefore has exactly as many fill cells as a data row; the audit reports table-columns-misaligned.
_meta.chartModel: A graph ALWAYS spans the full width available to it: the bar row fills the panel and each bar column fills its share, so the bars distribute across the whole card. Never a fixed ChartBar width — the audit reports it as chart-fixed-width. A graph is also ALWAYS read against ONE baseline at the FLOOR of its panel: the row is align "bottom-left", each column align "bottom-center", and both carry fillHeight so the block grows into the height the card really got (bento cards are stretched to the tallest panel of their row). Only the bar HEIGHT encodes the value; never fake the baseline with paddingTop offsets. The audit reports chart-baseline for staggered bar bottoms and chart-not-bottom-anchored for dead space under the graph, and the runtime re-seats every graph after each render/edit (anchorChartsToCardBottom).
_meta.placeholders: <Angle brackets> mark content the agent MUST replace. <Trailing?> marks an optional node: drop it when no content applies, never render it empty.

dashboard.action-row.purpose: Hug row of page-level actions: an optional icon action plus at most one Brand action. An icon-only Button MUST get a verified icon — without one it renders the library's "<Icon>" placeholder as an empty ✕ box, so drop the node or use a labelled Button instead.

dashboard.text-cell.purpose: One text column of a data row.

dashboard.badge-cell.purpose: Status column: a semantic Badge that keeps its column width.

dashboard.link-cell.purpose: Trailing action column: a small internal Link.

dashboard.list-row.purpose: Data row: equal text columns, a status badge and a trailing link.

dashboard.list-row-stacked.purpose: Data row whose leading column stacks a name over a secondary line.

dashboard.panel-title-row.purpose: Padded heading pair for a full-bleed panel: the Card carries spacing "none" so its dividers run edge to edge, so the title brings its own padding.

dashboard.table-header-row.purpose: Table header: select-all checkbox plus the column captions.

dashboard.table-row.purpose: Selectable table row: checkbox with the row name, values, status badge, link.

dashboard.row-divider.purpose: Weak horizontal rule separating two data rows.

dashboard.kpi-card.purpose: KPI card: label with status badge, large value, description and a semantic Infotext.

dashboard.goal-card.purpose: Goal card: label, large percentage, determinate progress bar and a deadline line.

dashboard.chart-bar-row.purpose: Full-width bar row: one fill-width column per value, so the bars spread across the whole panel. `fillHeight` makes the row take the height the panel actually has, so the baseline sits on the card floor instead of floating under the title.

dashboard.chart-bar-column.purpose: One fill-width chart bar with its centered caption underneath. Only the HEIGHT encodes the value — the width always fills the column, and `fillHeight` + `align: "bottom-center"` seat the bar and its caption on the shared baseline.

dashboard.card-title.purpose: Card heading pair: h4 headline with a small description.

dashboard.page-title.purpose: Page title row: h1 on the left, the action row pushed to the right.
